title: Application of Western Massachusetts Electric Company, under the provisions of G.L. c. 164, Section 94G, as amended by St. 1981, c. 375 and the Company's tariff, M.D.P.U. 896, for approval by the department of Public utilities of a semi-annual fuel charge as adopted in D.P.U. 95-8A to be billed to the Company's customers pursuant to meter readings in the billing months of September, October and November, 1997. Application is also made by Western Massachusetts Electric Company for approval by the Department of rates to be paid to Qualifying Facilities for purchases of power pursuant to 220 C.M.R.. 800 and M.D.P.U. 586 during the same time period.
